A Shadow at the Heart

You step so close that your enemy’s certainty falters before your blade arrives.

Rules

Action: Main Action · Attribute: Guile

Target / range / shape: One adjacent creature.

Make a melee attack from the closest, least expected angle. If you began Hidden, gain 1 Boon, then end Hidden.

- Weak: 5 physical damage. - Standard: 5 physical damage and Dazed 1. - Strong: 7 physical damage and Dazed 2.

Duration: Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.

Equipment / acquisition: Use one ordinary melee weapon; gain one on learning this card if you do not own one. Bulk 1.

---

Tier / minimum level: 7 · DP: 8 · Requirements to learn: Subterfuge 3

Type: Skill / Attack

Limits: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

ID: a-shadow-at-the-heart
